articles.title: Letters: Rail Road Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting. Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Rail Road use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Rail Road for 39 years, and I want to say what a difference Scout Troop 14 has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Stella Baptiste, Tannery Flats
